cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take the book bag; you take the clothes. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me carry the books for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And have you looking after me more than I'm looking after you? Keep the clothes; I'll slow down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put half the books in my bag, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. I'll pass you the paperbacks. The hardbacks stay with me.
